en.name: Cassava, frozen
en.summary: Frozen peeled cassava keeps 10–18 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Once boiled, keep it covered at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within 3–4 days. Freezing does not remove the cyanogenic compounds in cassava — it must still be cooked thoroughly.
en.pantry: There is no room-temperature storage for frozen cassava. It goes from the freezer straight into the pot, and a bag left to thaw on the counter is both a food-safety problem and a texture problem: the chunks go waterlogged and cook woolly. More importantly, cassava must be thoroughly cooked whatever form you buy it in. Freezing does nothing to the cyanogenic glycosides in the root, so undercooked cassava is the same hazard frozen as fresh — boil it until a fork goes through with no resistance at all.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, once it has been boiled — the general figure for a cooked dish. Cooked cassava sets hard and starchy in the fridge, which is normal; reheat it in its cooking liquid, or cut it up and fry it, rather than microwaving it dry. Do not use the fridge to thaw raw frozen chunks for later cooking, since you gain nothing: cassava is meant to be cooked from frozen.
en.freezer: 10–18 months at −18 °C (0 °F) in the unopened bag. That is a best-quality window rather than a safety limit — cassava kept continuously at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely, and what you are judging is the food, not the date. Reseal the bag tightly once opened, or the chunks frost-burn white and cook woolly. The figure is read across from commercially frozen vegetables, since frozen cassava is peeled, trimmed and usually blanched before freezing and behaves the same way; no agency publishes one for cassava itself. Do not thaw and refreeze.
en.thawing: Do not thaw — boil from frozen. If a bag has thawed in the fridge and is still at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, it may be refrozen with some quality loss; a bag thawed on the counter or in warm water must not be refrozen.
spoilage: White, dry, frost-burned patches on the chunks — freezer burn, a quality fault.
A block of chunks frozen solid together, meaning the bag part-thawed and refroze.
Grey, blue or dark streaks running through a thawed chunk, which belong in the bin.
A sour or fermented smell from cooked cassava kept too long in the fridge.
tips: Cook it from frozen; there is no advantage in thawing.
Boil until completely soft — cassava is never eaten undercooked.
Press the air out and reseal the bag; air is what causes freezer burn.
Reheat cooked cassava in liquid or fry it; dry reheating makes it chalky.

faq.q: How long does frozen cassava keep?
faq.a: 10–18 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe beyond that; the window is about freezer burn and texture.

faq.q: Do you need to thaw frozen cassava before cooking?
faq.a: No. Boil it straight from frozen until a fork goes through with no resistance.

faq.q: Is frozen cassava safe to eat undercooked?
faq.a: No. Freezing does not remove the cyanogenic compounds in cassava, so it must be cooked thoroughly, exactly as the fresh root must.

zh.name: 冷凍樹薯
zh.summary: 去皮冷凍樹薯塊在 −18 °C 下可保有最佳品質 10～18 個月。煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下，3～4 天內吃完。冷凍不會去掉樹薯裡的氰苷——它一樣必須徹底煮熟。
zh.pantry: 冷凍樹薯沒有室溫保存這個選項。它應該從冷凍直接下鍋，而一包擱在檯面上退冰的樹薯，既是食安問題也是口感問題：塊狀會吸飽水，煮起來像棉絮。更重要的是，不管你買的是哪一種形態，樹薯都必須徹底煮熟。冷凍對根部裡的氰苷完全沒有作用，所以沒煮透的冷凍樹薯和沒煮透的新鮮樹薯是同一種風險——請煮到叉子插下去完全沒有阻力為止。
zh.fridge: 煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，這是熟食的一般期限。熟樹薯在冷藏會變硬、變得很澱粉感，那是正常的；回熱請泡在原本的湯汁裡加熱，或切塊去煎去炸，不要乾乾地微波。不要為了之後要煮而用冷藏解凍生的冷凍樹薯塊，那沒有任何好處：樹薯本來就該從冷凍直接煮。
zh.freezer: 未拆封放 −18 °C 下 10～18 個月。那是最佳品質的期間，不是安全上限——全程維持在 −18 °C 的樹薯可以無限期保持安全，你要判斷的是食物本身，不是日期。拆封後請確實密封，否則塊狀表面會凍燒發白，煮起來變棉絮。這個數字是比照市售冷凍蔬菜而來，因為冷凍樹薯在冷凍前已經去皮、修整，通常也汆燙過，行為完全一樣；沒有機關為樹薯本身公布期限。不要解凍後又冷凍。
zh.thawing: 不要解凍，直接從冷凍下鍋煮。如果整包是在冷藏解凍、而且維持在 4 °C 以下，可以再冷凍，只是品質會打折；在檯面上或溫水裡解凍過的，絕對不能再冷凍。
spoilage: 塊狀表面出現乾白的凍燒斑——那是品質問題。
整包凍成一大塊，表示它曾經半退冰又再凍回去。
解凍後的塊狀裡有灰色、藍色或深色條紋，那就該丟。
冷藏放太久的熟樹薯聞起來發酸或有發酵味。
tips: 從冷凍直接煮，解凍沒有任何好處。
煮到完全軟透——樹薯永遠不能半生不熟地吃。
壓出空氣再封好袋子；凍燒就是空氣造成的。
熟樹薯回熱請帶湯汁或用煎的；乾式加熱會讓它變得粉粉的。

faq.a: −18 °C 下 10～18 個月品質最好。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；這個期限講的是凍燒和口感。

faq.q: 冷凍樹薯要先退冰再煮嗎？
faq.a: 不用。直接從冷凍下鍋煮，煮到叉子插下去完全沒有阻力。

faq.q: 冷凍樹薯可以不用煮熟嗎？
faq.a: 不行。冷凍不會去掉樹薯裡的氰苷，所以和新鮮樹薯一樣，必須徹底煮熟。
